annotations.title: Browse and fill in automation recipes

description: Works with the recipe library. action list returns the published recipes as cards, one page at a time. action instantiate fills one recipe in with params and returns the automation document (ir) with its validation report; it writes nothing, so saving the document is a separate step. Read-only.

action.description: list for the recipe library; instantiate to turn one recipe, named by slug, with its params, into an automation document.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

connection_id.description: For action list: marks the recipes that cannot work on this number.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

slug.description: The recipe’s slug, from the recipe list.

name: automation_recipes
title: Browse and fill in automation recipes
